passage:
proportion — 比例；部分
The proportion of students using the app as their main source of information rose from 0% to 54%.

reliance — 依赖
The website's share dropped slightly, from 18% to 15%, while reliance on friends' messages declined from 20% to 10%.

assume — 假定；假设
"We cannot assume that the app alone caused the fall." Other factors, such as the time of year and the specific courses running, could also have influenced attendance.

declined — 下降；减少（decline的过去式）
The website's share dropped slightly, from 18% to 15%, while reliance on friends' messages declined from 20% to 10%.

caution — 谨慎；警告
Marsh warned that these numbers should be treated with caution.

revealed — 揭示；显示（reveal的过去式）
Student feedback revealed hidden assumptions in the project's original design.

concluded — 总结；得出结论（conclude的过去式）
Marsh concluded, "A useful tool is not the same as a complete solution.

tailored — 调整；定制（tailor的过去分词）
This preference suggests that communication channels may need to be tailored to different age groups rather than relying on a single app for everyone.
